title: Account for debt settlement and restructuring

items.concept: Troubled debt modification — no gain when total future cash flows exceed debt carrying amount; new effective rate; multi-period amortization schedule; period-end interest JEs; maturity settlement
Number-variant twin — troubled debt modification with CF > CA; new effective rate; subsequent measurement schedule; period-end JEs; maturity settlement

Debtor accounting for settlement by asset transfer, settlement by equity issuance, and modification when total future cash payments are less than debt carrying amount (immediate gain; zero subsequent effective rate)
Classification/method — debtor decision rule for gain vs new effective rate on modification; asset settlement measurement sequence (FV then restructuring gain)
